title: Still enrolled, and sharing a numbered owner or manager with a revoked agency
question: After Medicare revoked a hospice or home-health agency, do the same owners or managers appear on agencies that are still enrolled and paid?
finding: 175 hospices and home-health agencies still enrolled in Medicare in October 2026 have an owner whose federal owner number also held an ownership interest in a revoked California agency; Medicare paid those 175 $303.1 million in 2024. Counting officers, directors and managing employees as well, 409 still-enrolled agencies ($528.2 million in 2024) share a numbered person or company with a revoked one. 4 are in the six Bay Area counties: Sojourn Hospice & Palliative Care -East Bay, LLC. (Pleasanton, hospice, $10.8 million in 2024; shares 1 federal owner number(s) with Optimal Home Health Care Inc.); Owen Healthcare LLC (San Francisco, hospice, $4.3 million in 2024; shares 2 federal owner number(s) with Los Robles Healthcare LLC); Blossom Ridge Health LLC (San Francisco, home-health agency, $2.7 million in 2024; shares 4 federal owner number(s) with Blossom Ridge Home Health Agency LLC); Owen Healthcare LLC (Oakland, home-health agency, $2.4 million in 2024; shares 2 federal owner number(s) with Los Robles Healthcare LLC).
how: Every owner, officer, director and managing employee the federal owner files ever listed for a revoked California hospice or home-health agency (15 quarterly files, April 2023 to October 2026) was collected by federal owner number, an exact identifier that follows a person or company across enrolments. Each agency still in the October 2026 enrolment file, and not itself revoked, was then checked for the same numbers among its current owners and managers. "An ownership interest in both" means the number holds 5% or more, directly or indirectly, or a partnership interest, in each. People are shown as codes; companies are named. Medicare payments are from the provider payment files; the score is the federal hospice Service and Spending Variation Index for fiscal 2025 (0 is the target range, 16 the highest outliers).
limits: Sharing an owner or a manager with a revoked agency is not a finding against the agency still enrolled: Medicare knows of the tie from these same files and has left the enrolment in place. A medical director, administrator or consultant commonly works for several agencies. A revocation for "affiliation" may itself rest on a tie of this kind rather than on anything the revoked agency billed. The owner files start in April 2023, so earlier owners are not seen.
